Logic Analysis: pom.xml
dependency/build; Maven build descriptor. Declares Java 11, junit-jupiter (test scope), and Maven Surefire plugin pinned for JUnit 5 to ensure tests run. No additional runtime dependencies.
src/main/java/Main.java
runtime/bootstrap (environment-dependent); Thin demo entrypoint in default package. Instantiates Calculator, evaluates a few expressions, prints results and bounded history, then exits.
src/main/java/Calculator.java

orchestration; Canonical public API. Responsibilities: coordinate Tokenizer and Parser, wrap outcomes into CalculationResult, manage CalculationHistory bounded storage, expose history() and clearHistory(). Depends on Tokenizer, Parser, CalculationHistory, HistoryEntry, CalculationResult.
src/main/java/Tokenizer.java

pure-rule; Tokenizes arithmetic expressions. Produces List<Token> from input string, skipping whitespace. Recognizes numbers (decimals), operators (+, -, *, /), parentheses, and EOF. Throws TokenizationException on invalid characters or malformed numbers. Depends on Token, TokenType, TokenizationException.
src/main/java/Token.java
domain-entity; Value object holding TokenType type, original text, and optional numericValue for NUMBER tokens. Used by Tokenizer and Parser.
src/main/java/TokenType.java
domain-entity; Enum categories: NUMBER, PLUS, MINUS, STAR, SLASH, LPAREN, RPAREN, EOF.
src/main/java/Parser.java

pure-rule; Recursive-descent parser and evaluator. Honors operator precedence (*, / over +, -), left associativity, parentheses, and unary minus. Evaluates tokens to a double. Throws ParseException or EvaluationException (including DivisionByZeroException). Depends on Token, TokenType, ParseException, EvaluationException, DivisionByZeroException.
src/main/java/CalculationResult.java
domain-entity; DTO encapsulating either success with double result or failure with non-null error message. Immutable externally visible API consumed by callers and tests.
src/main/java/CalculationHistory.java
domain-entity; Bounded in-memory history store with insertion order retrieval. Evicts oldest entries when capacity exceeded. Provides add, getAll, clear, capacity, size. Depends on HistoryEntry.
src/main/java/HistoryEntry.java
domain-entity; DTO capturing: expression string, success flag, optional numeric result (Double), optional error message. Used by CalculationHistory and exposed via Calculator.history().
src/main/java/CalculatorException.java
pure-rule; Base checked exception for calculator internals. Provides message-only constructor.
src/main/java/TokenizationException.java
pure-rule; Specific for tokenization errors, extends CalculatorException.
src/main/java/ParseException.java
pure-rule; Specific for parse errors (e.g., mismatched parentheses, incomplete expressions), extends CalculatorException.
src/main/java/EvaluationException.java
pure-rule; Specific for evaluation errors (generic arithmetic domain errors), extends CalculatorException.
src/main/java/DivisionByZeroException.java
pure-rule; Specialization of EvaluationException for division by zero. Provides default message.
src/test/java/MainTest.java
automated-test; Single JUnit 5 test file. Tests Calculator API wiring: precedence with unary minus, division by zero error propagation without escaping exceptions, and bounded history behavior.

headless_testing_risks: None; tests use only the Calculator API and do not depend on console output or environment-specific behavior.

Required Other language third-party pack: Maven Surefire Plugin pinned to a JUnit 5-compatible version (e.g., 2.22.2 or newer that supports JUnit 5)

Test Scope Plan: Runtime wiring and precedence: evaluate("-3 + 4*2/(1-5)") returns success with result -5.0 (unary minus and precedence with parentheses).
Error propagation: evaluate("1/0") returns failure CalculationResult with a non-null error message (division by zero), and no exceptions escape the API.

History capacity: instantiate Calculator with historyCapacity=2, perform three evaluations (mix of success and error), then assert history size equals 2 and entries are the last two in insertion order.
